text: Measurement every fourth day instead of every second day. The next-run date in the top bar follows.
Measurement every second day instead of daily, to halve the cost. A run started by hand still goes ahead at any time.

Changes after an audit of the numbers. Engines are shown as the API models that approximate ChatGPT and Google AI Mode. Position counts stores only: price comparison, classifieds and review sites take no place. Named first, top 3 and average position are counted per prompt, the same unit as visibility. "Visibility up", "Visibility down" and "ahead of" appear only for a difference of at least 3 prompts. New filter "Without prompt 4", because prompt 4 names a competitor.
Personal accounts: everyone signs in with their own e-mail and password instead of one shared password. Anyone with access can invite or remove people in the Access view.

Checklist view: the AI readiness checklist (122 items) for each store, with progress and a plain-language explanation of every item. Each store ticks its own items; some items are checked automatically on the public websites.
New look of the panel: navigation rail, header card with the verdict and change pills.
Google AI Mode answers come from the Gemini API with Google Search grounding; OpenRouter stays as a fallback. The run log shows which way each run went.
Run status in the top bar and a run log in How it works. Links open the same view, store, run and filters. A scheduled run is skipped when someone already ran the measurement by hand that day.
Rank-tracker layout: summary, rankings, position history, competitors and sources for each store, with a view of all stores together.
First version: daily measurement of 25 prompts per store in ChatGPT and Google AI Mode, encrypted results and a password-protected panel.
